title: [FancyZones CLI] Help examples use a payload name that is not exposed on PATH
summary: FancyZones help advertises the internal payload name, not the public CLI shim that the installer puts on PATH.
next_action: Align both resource-backed and hard-coded help, recovery guidance, and examples with PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe; check executable output and installed command resolution separately.

judgment.rationale: Source confirms the mismatch in both FancyZonesCliUsage and resource-backed root syntax and recovery guidance. Installer authoring names PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe for both scopes. The reporter examined extracted packages; installed-product command resolution and candidate output have not been independently run.
evidence: FancyZonesCliUsage.PrintUsage reads Resources.usage_syntax and prints hard-coded examples; PrintCommandUsage reads Resources.usage_run_help for an unknown command: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/6b3db15615e3e549b89790e0bd83c82d262c22e0/src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesCLI/CommandLine/FancyZonesCliUsage.cs.

Resources.resx advertises FancyZonesCLI in usage_syntax, usage_run_help, get_layouts_usage and the two PowerShell error examples: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/6b3db15615e3e549b89790e0bd83c82d262c22e0/src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesCLI/Properties/Resources.resx.

Installer authoring defines the installed filename PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe and separate user/machine PATH entries: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/6b3db15615e3e549b89790e0bd83c82d262c22e0/installer/PowerToysSetupVNext/CliShims.wxs#L13-L18.
judgment.recommended_action: Verify the installed public command and keep the internal payload directory off PATH.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix surfaced. The mismatch is in the help text rather than in command dispatch.

proposed_fixes.title: Use the public FancyZones CLI name in help and examples
proposed_fixes.root_cause: FancyZonesCliUsage hard-coded examples and Resources.resx usage_syntax, usage_run_help, get_layouts_usage and PowerShell recovery examples advertise the internal FancyZonesCLI payload name instead of the installed PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe shim.
plan: Use PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe in FancyZonesCliUsage root examples, subcommand usage and command examples.

Correct Resources.resx keys usage_syntax, usage_run_help, get_layouts_usage, error_powershell_scriptblock_option1_example and error_powershell_scriptblock_option2_example without renaming keys or internal identifiers.
Leave the shim mapping and installer PATH behavior unchanged.

Check executable output for root help, every subcommand and alias, unknown-command-with-help recovery, and PowerShell scriptblock recovery. No dedicated CLI help test project was found; do not claim automated coverage already exists.
verification: Capture --help and an unknown-command --help invocation; assert root syntax and recovery guidance name the public shim, and check every subcommand/alias help example.

From a fresh terminal outside the install directory, resolve PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe and run --help after both per-user and machine installs. Test get-monitors separately: configuration errors do not imply command lookup failed.

confidence.rationale: The output consumers, five resource keys and installed filename are confirmed in pinned source. Candidate executable output and real per-user/machine command resolution remain untested.

actions.label: Verify the FancyZones help commands in an installed build

reproduce.title: Compare advertised FancyZones command names with installed command lookup
reproduce.version_requirement: Stable 0.102.3101.0 or preview 0.103.3151.0 plus a candidate build
prerequisites: Disposable Windows environment for per-user and machine installations.
setup: Enable the installer CLI PATH option, then start a fresh terminal in an unrelated directory; do not edit global PATH for the test.
steps: Resolve PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe in the fresh terminal and record its full path; compare command lookup for the internal FancyZonesCLI.exe without changing PATH.
Run the public shim with --help, get-monitors --help and a deliberately unknown subcommand followed by --help; inspect resource-backed syntax, subcommand usage, examples and recovery guidance.
On the candidate build, repeat the output checks for all command names and aliases and the PowerShell scriptblock recovery examples.
Separately run the displayed get-monitors example. Record launch success independently from any FancyZones configuration or runtime error.
reproduce.expected_result: Root syntax, subcommand usage, examples and recovery guidance advertise PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe. The installed public shim resolves without adding the payload directory to PATH; any later command/configuration failure is reported separately.

actions.label: Align FancyZones help with the installed command name

issue_context.summary: FancyZones CLI help describes a command name not exposed by the installer.
known_information: The reporter confirmed the mismatch in extracted signed stable and preview payloads; this was not installed-product validation.
inferences: Changing the help text should address the mismatch without changing what the shim launches.
issue_context.analysis: Changing FancyZonesCliUsage alone would leave root syntax and unknown-command recovery incorrect because they come from Resources.resx. The same resource also supplies a get-layouts hint and two PowerShell recovery examples. Correct these user-facing invocations without changing internal identifiers or packaging. This differs from #52186, where the reporter reached the CLI using the correct shim and received a missing-layout-file error.
initial_investigation: Root and subcommand examples use the internal executable name in FancyZonesCliUsage.cs: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/084281ef6b137aa47a1e6a8e1e7bf79b0fe0378e/src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesCLI/CommandLine/FancyZonesCliUsage.cs
The public entry point and relative target are defined in the shim manifest: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/084281ef6b137aa47a1e6a8e1e7bf79b0fe0378e/tools/CliShim/CliShimManifest.props
Pinned current source confirms resource-backed root syntax, unknown-command guidance, get-layouts hint and PowerShell error examples also need correction.
The installed .exe suffix and user/machine PATH authoring are confirmed in CliShims.wxs at the pinned revision; no build, installation or executable-output test was performed.
information_gaps: Confirm installed PATH behavior separately for per-user and machine installations.

status.label: Needs Repro
status.detail: Help-name mismatch confirmed in source; installed-product verification remains.
